record.question: The baby climbed_________ the table.
record.explanation: Answer B: onto. “Onto” marks movement to a surface. Independent check: “Onto” expresses movement to a position on the table’s surface. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/onto. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
